thesis: Salesforce is the second software franchise 2026 has priced for agentic disruption while its numbers say otherwise: the stock is down ~30% YTD (-45% from highs, a three-year low) on the fear that AI agents retire the seats it has sold since 1999 - yet Q1 FY2027 delivered GAAP EPS +52%, $6.6B quarterly FCF (+4%), Agentforce ARR of $1.2B growing +205% y/y, and initiated FY27 guidance of $45.8-46.2B (+10-11%) with re-acceleration expected in H2. At ~$138.8B (~12-14x forward earnings, ~10x FCF) with a $25B buyback running, it is the cheapest large-cap software has traded in the modern era. Offsets: five acquisitions this year (deal-fatigue is real), layoffs, and the seat-cannibalization question is legitimate.
catalysts: Q2 FY2027 results (~late August 2026); H2 organic re-acceleration is management's stated checkpoint
Agentforce ARR trajectory ($1.2B, +205% y/y) - the direct rebuttal to the seat-erosion thesis
$25B buyback executing at ~10x FCF (retires ~4-5%/yr at these prices)
Acquisition digestion pause (a stated de-risking signal the market wants)
FY27 guidance delivery: 10-11% growth against a price implying decline
risk_factors: Seat cannibalization: agents replacing human CRM users attacks per-seat pricing - the identical structural fear as ADBE, and equally unresolved
Serial acquisitions (five in 2026 incl. Fin and a pricing platform) - capital-allocation trust is damaged; each deal drops the stock
Agentforce contribution called 'modest' against a weak outlook in earlier prints - the +205% is off a small base
SBC (~3B+/yr historically) flatters headline FCF; per-share economics require the buyback just to stand still on dilution
Fair-value cuts and cautious notes (RBC, BofA, June 2026) show the analyst floor is still descending

fy2027_revenue_guidance.note: +10-11% y/y; OCF growth guided +9-10%; H2 re-acceleration expected

market_cap.note: trailing P/E 19.28, forward 11.92-14.2 across sources; stock at a three-year low, -45% from highs
